title: Main Idea — Practice B: Stated Idea

author: Chee Skool

curriculum.learningObjective: Identify a stated main idea and verify how later details develop it.

questions.prompt: Select the sentence that most directly states the overall idea developed by the rest of the passage.

targets.text: Sleep supports how well teenagers function each day by affecting their brains, emotions, and bodies.
During sleep, the brain organizes information and prepares for the next day.
Physical health is affected as well.

explanation.whyCorrect: It controls the rest of the passage by naming the three branches that follow: brain, emotions, and body.
explanation.quickTip: A stated main idea often predicts the structure that follows.

questions.hint: Look for the sentence broad enough to cover all three later branches.

questions.prompt: Match each supporting detail to the branch of the stated main idea it develops.

items.text: Memory, attention, problem-solving, and decision-making can suffer.
Stress, irritability, frustration, and sadness can feel stronger.
Sleep supports appetite regulation, repair, and immune function.

explanation.answer: Brain: i1; Emotions: i2; Physical health: i3.
explanation.whyCorrect: Each detail develops one branch named in the controlling sentence.
explanation.quickTip: Ask how each detail helps develop the stated main idea, not merely whether it is true.

questions.prompt: Which statement best summarizes the passage as a whole?

options.text: Sleep mainly helps teenagers remember schoolwork and make better decisions.
options.whyWrong: This covers only the brain branch.

options.text: Sleep affects teenagers’ cognitive, emotional, and physical functioning, so getting enough sleep helps them function better overall.
Teenagers who sleep poorly may make unhealthy food choices.
A fixed sleep schedule prevents all health problems in teenagers.
options.whyWrong: The passage does not make this absolute claim.

explanation.whyCorrect: It includes all three major branches without adding an unsupported promise.
explanation.quickTip: A main idea should cover the major branches, not just repeat a true detail.

description: Stated-main-idea practice using a teen-sleep source adaptation.
